sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission investigated how the Shire of Dowerin's chief executive officer could steal public money over several years without detection.
sentences.support: The Commission decided to investigate the circumstances in which Mr Alcock was able to steal so much money over such a long period without detection.

sentences.text: Its examination covered council oversight, financial controls and the failure of successive audits to detect the theft.
sentences.support: Successive audits had failed to discover anything wrong with the accounts.

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that stronger policies, an audit committee and scrutiny of credit card statements would probably have exposed the theft earlier.
sentences.support: the probabilities are that the embezzlement would have been discovered much sooner and the losses mitigated.

sentences.text: It formed no serious misconduct opinions about Shire officers or councillors and stressed councils' responsibility for governing local government affairs.
sentences.support: The Commission has formed no opinions of serious misconduct about officers and councillors of the Shire of Dowerin.

notes: Existing OPAX findings are not duplicated. The report expressly declines to form serious misconduct opinions. No separate numbered recommendations list.
